They have basically a single vector message which is, we make crackers grown with regenerative practices. And the thing that was surprising to me is there is an emerging consumer who's very, very focused on that one single vector of regenerative - because it's very easy to explain to people why it's a big deal. And just in listening to you, the regenerative is the thing you keep coming back to. So I would - I'm out, just because we've done a handful of food businesses, including that one. Ironically, that company also has a software arm that helps food manufacturers roll out regenerative practices through their supply chain. Turns out that's an easier business to scale than the crackers. But the crackers have done quite well, as a product. So I think the missing ingredient here is a retail marketer, and someone who can really help you kind of figure out - like, what's the one thing you want the company to be known for? And if it's helpful to put you in touch with our cracker company, I'm happy to do that.
